inlineSql: UPDATE MAIN_STOCK SET ITM_SIZE = '' WHERE ITM_SIZE Is NULL

SELECT A.ITM_SIZE AS ItSize FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO <> 'N' AND A.ITM_SIZE <> ''
